title: First Allagash sighting: sphere of light at Mud Pond
place_text: Mud Pond campsite, Chamberlain Lake, Allagash Waterway, Maine

tellings.quote: Uh, and a member of this other group said, "What the hell is that over there?" And we looked on the other side of the lake and here's this sphere of light and it's moving like a balloon moving very very slowly but it's like moving into this wind.

plain: Charlie Foltz says that in 1976 he was camping with friends, among them Jim Weiner, at the Mud Pond campsite on Chamberlain Lake, along the Allagash Waterway in the woods of Maine. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that someone from another group of campers shouted "What the hell is that over there?", and across the lake they all saw a sphere of light drifting very slowly, like a balloon, but moving into the wind. He tells it as the first strange sighting of a trip that he says later turned into an alien abduction.
